_note: Deterministic, fixable invalid_move scenario for the bounded proposal-repair module. A cycle a -> core -> b -> a exists; the first cut names a destination that is NOT an internal node ('nope'), so the primitive refuses with MOVE_TO_NOT_AN_INTERNAL_DIR. The correct destination 'b' IS an internal node and covers the whole imported-name set of the b -> a edge, so the second cut computes. The legal destination is one of THIS fixture's own graph nodes (never a fresh find/grep, never a hardcoded answer).
